{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on: push
name: Build & Test
env:
  MIX_ENV: test

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Ex${{matrix.elixir}}/OTP${{matrix.otp}}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      matrix:
        elixir: ["1.15.8", "1.16.3", "1.17.3", "1.18.2"]
        otp: ["25.3.2", "26.2.5", "27.2.4"]
        exclude:
          - elixir: "1.15.8"
            otp: "27.2.4"
          - elixir: "1.16.3"
            otp: "27.2.4"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          otp-version: ${{matrix.otp}}
          elixir-version: ${{matrix.elixir}}
      - run: mix deps.get
      - run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors
      - run: mix test",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no job timeout, so a hung or runaway job can consume unbounded runner time. The P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT experiment evidence shows adding timeout-minutes: 5 to CI jobs produced measured elapsed savings (3.45% and 6.25%) with equal successful conclusions in both arms on forked CI workflows, and no reported false timeouts. Repository CI history shows five successful runs, most completing well under a minute, supporting a five-minute bound derived from successful history. The change is minimal, adds only timeout-minutes: 5 to the existing test job, and preserves the full matrix, build, compile, and test coverage with no steps removed or permissions changed.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-ca499b3aaef0d029", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336"]
}
